history.summary: ISKCON (International Society for Krishna Consciousness) temple in Raj Nagar, Block 11, at ISKCON Chowk on Hare Krishna Marg, Ghaziabad. Part of the Gaudiya Vaishnava movement founded by A.C. Bhaktivedanta Swami Prabhupada in 1966. Exact founding date of the Ghaziabad centre is not documented in the consulted sources (verify).

name: ISKCON Temple, Raj Nagar
town_description: Industrial city in western Uttar Pradesh, part of the National Capital Region on the Delhi–Meerut corridor; a major rail and road hub with Ghaziabad Junction, Delhi Metro Red Line and the RRTS linking it to Delhi.

travel.airport: Indira Gandhi International Airport, Delhi, ~45 km (verify)
travel.road: Hare Krishna Marg, Block 11, Raj Nagar; nearest metro Shaheed Sthal (New Bus Adda), ~2.3 km

visitor_information.best_time: October–March; Janmashtami and Holi draw the largest crowds
visitor_information.opening_hours: 4:30 AM – 1:00 PM; sources differ on evening darshan hours (verify)
